disposition: Candidate 1 approved unchanged. Restrict seedless claims to deterministic protocols. Compare mixed protocols with both original targets under a pooled surplus. Independent scientific referee pending.

root_at_freeze.handling: Reoptimize each of the 120 pair mergers with the complete threshold and integer benchmark. Test simultaneous mergers rather than inferring from pairwise compatibility. Bound shared independent randomness on the convex hull of unconstrained protocols with one common supporting multiplier, keep the shared seed hidden from focal readers, and distinguish private noise and the feedback control.
root_at_freeze.strongest_objection: A disagreement in one published mask need not force distinct eraser messages: another sharp mask could use null labels, ties or unused integer surplus. Randomly mixing two codes under a pooled threshold can spend a branch's surplus on another.
